description: Big challenges inspire bold ideas. I'm Beshoy Khalil Hanna, a Network & Cyber ​​Security student at SUTech, passionate about technology and problem-solving. I've competed in international and regional problem-solving competitions, earned placements, and taken part in CTF challenges. I'm looking for curious, driven teammates with skills in GIS, remote sensing, agriculture, climate science, AI, data analysis, or software development. Let's turn NASA data into real impact!
